content: अपोहः .²1 Removing, driving away, healing <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Removal of doubt by the excercise of the reasoning faculty. .²3 Reasoning, arguing; reasoning faculty. .²4 Negative reasoning (<ab>opp.</ab> ऊह) (अपरतर्कनिरासाय कृतो विपरीतस्तर्कः), one of the {%dhiguṇas%} <ab>q. v.</ab> स्वयमूहापोहासमर्थः; इमे मनुष्या दृश्यन्ते ऊहापोहविशारदाः <ls>Mb. 13. 145. 43</ls>. ऊहापोहमिमं सरोजनयना यावद्विधत्तेतराम् <ls>Bv. 2. 74</ls>; hence ऊहापोह = complete discussion of a question. .²5 Excluding all things not coming under the category in point; तद्वानपोहो वा शब्दार्थः (where Maheśvara paraphrases अपोह by अतद्व्यावृत्ति {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} तद्भिन्नत्यागः), .²6 A superfluous member attached to a structure of some construction.
